methodology.sources: Each bundle resolves every production source from one exact committed tree. The attribution-only bundle resolves all files from candidate except road-contact.ts, which is the actual committed baseline file. No production or authored source is patched.
methodology.processIsolation: Each process has only one source variant and one vehicle or microbenchmark input kind. The same worker contains no second implementation. Every role/round/workload starts a fresh process; children execute sequentially.
methodology.timing: Fixed, predeclared equal warmup. Vehicle samples aggregate multiple identical 1200-substep episodes with fresh track and vehicle setup outside every timer. GC, setup, canonical serialization, hashing, and exact output comparisons are untimed. Wall and user/system CPU durations are retained for every warmup and measured episode.
methodology.inputScope: Natural rl2 and sk125 match W07B input and support-loss schedules on its analytic DynamicsTrack fixture. No authored AWD clutch coupling is enabled. Frame microbenchmarks separately use 128 actual unit-up rl2 input snapshots captured in an untimed process and 128 W07B diverse-normal inputs.
methodology.proof: Full production Simulation worlds execute formula practice, wet motorcycle practice, and motocross race. Packed Float32 frames and exposed dynamic car/race/AI state are captured every tick. Surface/weather arrays and sparse deformable-terrain checkpoints are captured every 120 ticks and at the end. Raw files are compared byte for byte, not merely by hashes.
stateExclusions: Shared authored definitions/setup/vehicle physics specifications and static circuit geometry are omitted from dynamic state capture
Contact BVH construction/layout counters and internal collision scratch are not treated as gameplay state
methodology.noSelection: No samples, outliers, warmups, or unfavorable runs are removed. Every started child and failed attempt remains in the report. Defaults are fixed before measurement; changing them creates a separate explicitly labelled report.
methodology.limits: Node CPU measurements on this runtime and host; no browser/GPU/FPS or other-machine claim. Actual circuit proof is correctness evidence, not a timed full-game benchmark. Analytic Vehicle timings exclude TrackContactMesh/BVH and race/AI/weather orchestration. JIT behavior can differ from CI Node22.
